caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular inn sign bordered in black and green, with rusty iron brackets extending upward at each top corner. The background inside the sign is predominantly a dark, reddish-brown color. At the center of the sign, there is a large black oval outlined in gold. Inside the oval, the text "S. WADSWORTH'S INN." is written in a curved formation at the top and bottom, in large gold letters. In the middle of the oval, there is an illustration of a gold eagle with outstretched wings facing to the right, its body overlaid with a shield bearing a blue top and red and white vertical stripes. The eagle is highlighted with gold and brown tones, and golden rays extend downward from the shield. In the lower left and lower right corners of the sign, outside the black oval, there are small gold ornate designs.
title: Tavern Sign
